message.content:
I don’t have real‑time data, so I can’t tell you the exact current time in New York City right now.  
New York City is in the Eastern Time Zone (UTC‑5 during standard time, UTC‑4 during daylight‑saving time). You can quickly find the current local time by:

1. Checking the clock on your phone/computer and switching the time zone to “Eastern Time (US & Canada)”.
2. Using an online world‑clock tool (e.g., Google “current time in New York” or visiting timeanddate.com/worldclock/usa/new-york).

If you need the time for a specific date or want to calculate sunrise/sunset for New York City, let me know and I can help with that!
